title: 第一卷 第19章 偶遇同门，刻意藏拙
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
整理好周身行装，收好剩余的极品月华草与古朴古卷。

    苏玄尘将自身气息再度压到最低，外表看去，依旧是那名白发苍苍、气息平平的百岁老者。

    他缓步走出藏身的密林树洞。

    林间雾气淡淡飘散，草木清香萦绕鼻尖。

    刚行出不远，两道身影便从斜前方的小道迎面走来。

    是两名结伴而行的外门女弟子，看装束与神态，应当也是深入秘境搜寻机缘的修士。

    两人修为都停留在炼气三层，资质中等，行事格外谨慎。

    一路走一路留意四周动静，目光不停扫过路边灵草，小心翼翼探寻前路。

    当看清迎面走来的苏玄尘时，两名女弟子先是脚步一顿，眼中露出几分惊讶。

    显然没料到，这位传闻中体弱年迈的同门，竟也走到了这片区域。

    “原来是苏师兄。”

    其中一名女子率先拱手行礼，语气温和，并无半分恶意。

    另一人跟着颔首，眼神里带着明显的惋惜。

    在整个青玄宗外门，几乎人人都知晓苏玄尘的情况。

    千年难遇的极品天灵根，偏偏生在了百岁老朽身上。

    肉身衰败，寿元无多，空有绝世天赋，却难以正常修行。

    “没想到师兄没有守在外围，反倒往这边来了。”

    圆脸女弟子轻声开口，语气里满是善意。

    在她们的认知里，苏玄尘年纪太大，肉身早已不堪重负，身法、体力都远不及年轻弟子。

    秘境外围尚且相对安全，越往深处，危险便成倍增加。

    “苏师兄，我二人刚刚从前面山谷过来。”

    另一名女弟子好心出言提醒，神色认真。

    “秘境深处妖兽越来越强，同门之间的争抢厮杀也从未断过。

    不少修为不弱的弟子，都在争斗里受了伤。”

    圆脸女弟子连忙补充，言语间满是担忧。

    “你修为本就不高，身躯又不比我们年轻人灵活，千万不要继续往深处走了。

    留在外围边缘搜寻灵草，安安稳稳待到试炼结束，才是最稳妥的选择。”
content_en:
Pack your belongings and put away the remaining top-quality moonflower grass and ancient scrolls.

    Su Xuanchen suppressed his aura to the lowest level again. From the outside, he was still the white-haired centenarian with a flat aura.

    He slowly walked out of the tree hole in the dense forest where he was hiding.

    The mist in the forest drifts lightly, and the fragrance of vegetation lingers on the tip of the nose.

    Just after walking a short distance, two figures came towards me from the path diagonally ahead.

    They were two female disciples from the outer sect traveling together. Judging from their attire and demeanor, they should also be monks who went deep into the secret realm to search for opportunities.

    Both of them are at the third level of Qi Refining, have average qualifications, and act extremely cautiously.

    As he walked, he paid attention to the movements around him, his eyes kept scanning the spiritual grass on the roadside, and he carefully explored the way forward.

    When they saw Su Xuanchen coming towards them clearly, the two female disciples paused for a moment, with a bit of surprise in their eyes.

    Obviously he didn't expect that this fellow student who was rumored to be frail and elderly would actually come to this area.

    "It turns out to be Senior Brother Su."

    One of the women took the lead in saluting with her hands raised, her tone gentle and without any malice.

    The other person nodded, with obvious regret in his eyes.

    In the entire outer sect of Qingxuan Sect, almost everyone knew about Su Xuanchen's situation.

    The best heavenly spiritual root, which is rare to find in a thousand years, happened to be born in a hundred-year-old man.

    His physical body is decaying, his lifespan is short, he has peerless talent, but it is difficult to practice normally.

    "I didn't expect that senior brother didn't guard the perimeter, but came here instead."

    The round-faced female disciple spoke softly, her tone full of kindness.

    In their understanding, Su Xuanchen was too old, his physical body was already overwhelmed, and his physical skills and physical strength were far inferior to those of young disciples.

    The outer reaches of the secret realm are relatively safe, but the danger increases exponentially as you go deeper.

    "Senior Brother Su, the two of us just came from the valley ahead."

    Another female disciple kindly reminded me with a serious expression.

    “The monsters in the depths of the secret realm are getting stronger and stronger, and the fights and fights between fellow sects have never stopped.

    Many disciples who were not weak in cultivation were injured in the fight. "

    The round-faced female disciple quickly added, her words full of worry.

    "Your cultivation level is not high, and your body is not as flexible as us young people. You must not go further into the depths.

    It is the safest choice to stay on the outer edge to search for spiritual herbs and wait peacefully until the trial is over. "
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 19 Encountering a fellow disciple by chance, deliberately hiding his clumsiness
